## Overview

An inline message that stays in the page flow and can be dismissed by the reader.

- **Kind:** Component
- **Stability:** `stable`
- **Since:** 1.0

## Selector

```text
vanta-alert
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | [`VantaTone`](/docs/reference/generated/vanta-tone) |  | Yes | Visual intent. Required so an alert never defaults to a misleading colour. |
| `alertTitle` (property `heading`) | `string` | `''` |  | Short heading shown above the message. Bound as `alertTitle`. |
| `dismissible` | `unknown` | `false` |  | Shows a close button when set. Accepts the bare attribute (`dismissible`). Transform `booleanAttribute`; reads as `boolean`. |

## Outputs

| Output | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dismissed` | `void` | Emits once, when the reader closes the alert. |

## Public methods

### dismiss

```ts
dismiss(): void
```

Closes the alert from code, exactly as the close button does.

## Related types

- [`VantaTone`](/docs/reference/generated/vanta-tone)

## Examples

```html
<vanta-alert tone="warning" alertTitle="Unsaved changes" dismissible (dismissed)="onDismissed()">
  Your draft has not been saved.
</vanta-alert>
```
